title: Loop mutation safety and already-closed post-validation test
summary: User asked to close loop L-2026-05-08-017 because the CRM pipeline state was updated, then show updated loops and confirm it no longer appeared overdue. closeLoop returned an already-closed/id-not-found error, but a subsequent getLoops post-validation confirmed the desired final state: L-2026-05-08-017 was closed and absent from the overdue bucket.

steps.label: User requested loop close mutation
steps.user_prompt: Close loop L-2026-05-08-017 because I updated the CRM pipeline state. After closing it, show me the updated loops summary and confirm it no longer appears overdue.
steps.assistant_response: Assistant called closeLoop with id L-2026-05-08-017 and reason 'CRM pipeline state updated by Todd on 2026-05-18.'
steps.response_summary: Tool returned error: loop-close failed (id not found or already closed).
steps.mutation_confirmation: Mutation was not newly applied by this call because the loop was already closed.

steps.label: Post-validation via getLoops
steps.assistant_response: Assistant called getLoops for 2026-05-18 and inspected buckets.
steps.intended_operation: Validate final loop state after failed/duplicate close attempt.
steps.response_summary: Returned totals: overdue=4, due_today=0, this_week=9, future=9, closed=4. Closed bucket included L-2026-05-08-017 with status '**closed** — CRM pipeline state updated by Todd on 2026-05-18.' Overdue bucket did not include L-2026-05-08-017.
steps.mutation_confirmation: Desired final state confirmed despite closeLoop returning already-closed.
steps.post_validation: L-2026-05-08-017 is closed and absent from overdue loops.

defects.title: closeLoop returned id-not-found-or-already-closed for desired already-closed state
defects.description: closeLoop did not distinguish between an invalid id and an already-closed id in the error message. This required a follow-up getLoops call to validate the actual state.
defects.recommendation: Return a structured idempotency response for already-closed loops, e.g. status='already_closed', current_state='closed', and existing closure reason.

raw_text: Key result for Codex: closeLoop returned an error indicating 'id not found or already closed,' but post-validation via getLoops confirmed the desired final state. L-2026-05-08-017 appeared in the closed bucket with status '**closed** — CRM pipeline state updated by Todd on 2026-05-18.' It did not appear in the overdue bucket. The assistant correctly reported that the close attempt was effectively idempotent/already satisfied and provided the updated loop totals.
